workflow.name: app project quota probe
workflow.browser_scope: native runner tests only; Chromium skipped

coverage: A real managed installation was stopped, reviewed for repair, checkpointed and restarted through the signed runner path.
The repaired generation passed probe, registration, boot and activation, then served a real current-viewer backend request while preserving the release, policy and grant tuple.
The installation was then disabled and a separate reviewed delete_data operation was admitted for its retained namespace.
The signed runner removed the actual namespace and the Portal settled the namespace as deleted with no owner and the operation at complete.
The same native flow completed managed uninstall and fresh reinstall without retaining the previous namespace.
limits: This is disposable Linux/Docker/XFS development acceptance. It is not production deployment evidence or an execution_ready claim.
The run is native-only and deliberately skips Chromium. Browser confirmation and progress for repair/restore are recorded separately in the lifecycle runner evidence.
Broader concurrent operator acceptance across enable, update and repair remains open.
